meaning:
1) to tithe, take the tenth part of, give a tithe, take a tithe
1a) (Qal) to tithe
1b) (Piel) to give a tithe
1c) (Hiphil) to take a tithe
glosses: must be sure to set aside a tenth

renderings.bsb: I will surely give You a tenth
You must be sure to set aside a tenth

renderings.kjv: And he will take the tenth
